question: Where will the 28th ITTF-ATTU Asian Table Tennis Team Championships be hosted in October 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhubaneswar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India will host the 28th ITTF-ATTU Asian Table Tennis Team Championships in Bhubaneswar from October 11 to 15, 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The event will feature men’s and women’s team competitions and will serve as a qualifier for the 2026 ITTF World Team Championships.**
 
• **Bhubaneswar is hosting its first Asian-level table tennis event, though the state previously hosted the 2019 Commonwealth Table Tennis Championships.**
 
• **The championship will feature top Asian teams such as China, Japan, South Korea, and Singapore.**
 
• **The tournament will follow international standards with ITTF-approved flooring and equipment.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__

 __

• Bhubaneswar, the state capital, has become a hub for sporting excellence.

 __
 
• Held regularly, it features team events from top Asian nations.
